ei.title: Culture Notes - Literature That Changed the Course of History

fullPassage: Harriet Beecher Stowe's 1852 novel Uncle Tom's Cabin contributed to historical change in the United States. The novel mainly follows Uncle Tom living a hard life as an African American slave. It also features Eliza and her son, who escape from slavery. The novel exposes the horrors of the slavery system and treating humans as property. After it was published, people in the North became increasingly against slavery. However, because the Southern economy relied on slave labor, people in the South still wanted to keep it. This conflict led to the Civil War, which contributed to the end of slavery. Although Stowe's novel didn't get rid of slavery by itself, it played an important role in bringing about its end.

questions.passage: Harriet Beecher Stowe's 1852 novel Uncle Tom's Cabin (A)[contributed / distributed] to historical change in the United States. The novel mainly follows Uncle Tom living a hard life as an African American slave. It also (B)[features / fractures] Eliza and her son, who escape from slavery. The novel exposes the horrors of the slavery system and treating humans as (C)[property / prosperity]. After it was published, people in the North became increasingly against slavery. However, because the Southern economy relied on slave labor, people in the South still wanted to keep it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 스토의 소설은 미국의 역사적 변화에 기여했다. 엘라이자와 그녀의 아들도 등장한다. 소설은 인간을 재산으로 취급하는 공포를 폭로한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① contributed — features — property
❌ ② distributed — fractures — prosperity
❌ ③ contributed — fractures — prosperity
❌ ④ distributed — features — property
✅ (A) contributed: 'contributed to(~에 기여하다)'. distributed(분배하다)는 부적절. ✅ (B) features: 소설이 인물을 '등장시키다'. fractures(골절시키다)는 부적절. ✅ (C) property: '재산'. prosperity(번영)는 문맥과 맞지 않음.
det.tip: contribute to: ~에 기여하다. feature: (작품이) 등장시키다. property: 재산, 소유물.

questions.passage: The novel (A)[exposes / encloses] the horrors of the slavery system and treating humans as property. After it was published, people in the North became (B)[increasingly / inclusively] against slavery. However, because the Southern economy (C)[relied / replied] on slave labor, people in the South still wanted to keep it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 소설은 노예 제도의 공포를 폭로한다. 북부 사람들은 점점 더 반대하게 되었다. 남부 경제는 노예 노동에 의존했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① encloses — inclusively — replied
❌ ② exposes — inclusively — replied
✅ ③ exposes — increasingly — relied
❌ ④ encloses — increasingly — relied
✅ (A) exposes: '폭로하다'. encloses(동봉하다)는 부적절. ✅ (B) increasingly: '점점 더'. inclusively(포괄적으로)는 부적절. ✅ (C) relied: 'relied on(~에 의존하다)'. replied(대답하다)는 문맥 불일치.
det.tip: expose: 폭로하다. increasingly: 점점 더. rely on: ~에 의존하다.

questions.passage: The novel exposes the horrors of the slavery system and treating humans as property. After it was published, people in the North became increasingly against slavery. However, because the Southern economy relied on slave labor, people in the South still wanted to keep it. This (A)[conflict / comfort] led to the Civil War, which contributed to the end of slavery. Although Stowe's novel didn't get rid of slavery by (B)[itself / herself], it played an important (C)[role / rule] in bringing about its end.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 이 갈등은 남북 전쟁으로 이어졌다. 스토의 소설이 그 자체로는 노예 제도를 없애지 못했지만, 중요한 역할을 했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① comfort — herself — rule
✅ ② conflict — itself — role
❌ ③ conflict — herself — rule
❌ ④ comfort — itself — role
✅ (A) conflict: 남북 대립 = '갈등'. comfort(위안)는 반대. ✅ (B) itself: novel(사물) → itself. herself는 사람. ✅ (C) role: 'play a role' 관용 표현. rule(규칙)은 부적절.
det.tip: conflict: 갈등, 충돌. by itself: 그 자체만으로. play a role in: ~에 역할을 하다.

det.korean: 톰 아저씨는 노예로서 힘든 삶을 산다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① ①
✅ ② ②
❌ ③ ③
❌ ④ ④
② comfortable(편안한) → hard(힘든): 원문에서 톰 아저씨는 노예로서 '힘든' 삶을 산다. comfortable은 정반대. ① contributed: 기여했다(적절). ③ escape: 탈출하다(적절). ④ property: 재산(적절).
det.tip: hard life(힘든 삶) vs comfortable life(편안한 삶): 노예의 삶이므로 hard가 적절.

questions.passage: After it was published, people in the North became increasingly ①<u>against</u> slavery. However, because the Southern economy relied on slave labor, people in the South still wanted to ②<u>keep</u> it. det.korean: 남북 전쟁은 노예 제도의 종식에 기여했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① ①
❌ ② ②
✅ ③ ③
❌ ④ ④
③ preservation(보존) → end(종식): 원문에서 남북 전쟁은 노예 제도의 '종식'에 기여. preservation은 반대. ① against: 반대하여(적절). ② keep: 유지하다(적절). ④ important: 중요한(적절).
det.tip: end(종식) vs preservation(보존): 남북 전쟁의 결과는 노예 제도 폐지.

① conceals(숨기다) → exposes(폭로하다): 원문에서 소설은 공포를 '폭로'한다. conceals는 반대. ② property: 재산(적절). ③ published: 출판되다(적절). ④ against: 반대하여(적절).
